items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then this was when he organized his band. And the funniest thing, boy, -- you know Willie Berg? ... Well, Willie Berg at that time was a little young Jewish -- he tried to play clarinet. But what he did, he had a kit about this big. And he'd put reeds and he'd put all of these -- and for years,

ctx.x: Where did these sessions take place in Kansas City?

They -- in a little joint called the Subway. And it was down in the basement, it was down in the basement. It was a restaurant on top of something, and then right down in the basement, they had this subway. It was like a little club, a little club. And this is where they would take place.

And I saw Basie about -- this was about a year ago, now, I don't know if he wants it repeated. This is an in thing, we were sitting up talking, and I said, 'do you remember Slam Foot? That was a piano player and he used to play a lot of the sessions. He said, 'man, you would be the only one in the world that would know something like that, yeah.' And then this was when he organized his band. And the funniest thing, boy, -- you know Willie Berg?
